lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Hello Rafael, it's Beth. Do you have a few minutes for our call?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hi Beth. Give me one second... okay, I'm here.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Great. So today I'd like to hear how the vegetables went, check how you're feeling, and pick a goal for next week. Anything you want to add?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: That works.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Are you feeling okay this week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Honestly, rough week. The hot flashes are back.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's hard to think about goals when your body isn't cooperating.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Half your plate has to be vegetables. That's the rule.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I just forgot. Church on Sunday always throws me off.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How do you want to handle the vegetables going forward?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'm going to do it Monday, Wednesday and Friday.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is your daughter able to help?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, I think so.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What could you try instead?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I know I can do it, I did it before.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You have to make this a priority.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Maybe.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're still figuring out what works.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I put a reminder on the fridge. I didn't think I'd like it, but I do.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You know your schedule better than anyone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What would your family say about these changes?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I need this for my head too, not just my body.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Frozen vegetables count just as much as fresh, and they're cheaper.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's been a mixed week.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, I want to get my energy back.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What do you think the next step should be?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Good question.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you buy frozen vegetables?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Not yet. I bought spinach and actually used it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Why is this important to you right now?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll set an alarm on my phone. Some days are better than others.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Once you decide something, you follow through.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I feel better about myself when I stick to it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: This is about more than the vegetables. It's about getting your life back.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Let's put you down to add a vegetable to lunch and dinner on 3 days next week.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I guess.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: On a scale of 0 to 10, how confident are you that you can do that?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: 8. Maybe 9.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What might get in the way?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll ask my son to come with me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Same time next Wednesday?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Perfect.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Talk soon!

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: God bless you.

tags.note: Acknowledges struggle beyond what was said
Recognizes his knowledge of his schedule
Personal reason for change; coach did not explore
Info offered without asking; skipped change talk
Invites participant to lead next step
Concrete step: bought and used spinach
Plans alarm; some sustain about variability
Sets goal for him rather than collaborating

flags.reason: 'You have to make this a priority' is a directive that pressures rather than collaborates, and it drew a hesitant 'Maybe.'
'That's the rule' imposes a rule without permission, right after the participant reported a rough week.
Participant's 'I need this for my head too' was a strong personal reason for change; coach skipped it and gave frozen-vegetable information.
Goal was set for the participant ('Let's put you down') rather than negotiated; he replied only 'I guess.'

score.summary: Rafael showed strong change talk around vegetables, confidence, and personal reasons, and he set a specific plan with a support person. The coach relied on directives and rules, skipped key change talk, and set the goal for him, which reduced partnership.
strengths: Line 7 and 25: acknowledged the rough week and hot flashes before moving to goals.
Line 20: affirmed Rafael's knowledge of his own schedule.
Line 39: used a confidence scale that surfaced his 8-9 rating and supported the plan.
Line 41: explored barriers and he named a support step (son) in line 42.
Line 43: set a clear next contact.
coaching_tips: Line 8 and 16: replace 'That's the rule' and 'You have to' with a question or permission-based offer.
Line 22: reflect 'I need this for my head too' back, then ask what that means to him.
Line 37: ask 'What feels like a realistic number of days to add vegetables?' before setting the goal.
Line 34 and 40: reflect his confidence and ask what would move it from 8 to 10.
Line 35: offer a summary before closing so he hears his own reasons back.
